title: Peanut leaf disease classification with transfer learning under leakage-controlled cross-validation: code, data splits and results
description:
Code (Google Colab notebooks), cross-validation split files, duplicate-audit results, per-image predictions, tables and figures for the article "Deep learning-based peanut leaf disease classification using transfer learning under leakage-controlled cross-validation" (Scientific Reports, under review).

Four ImageNet-pretrained backbones (ResNet-50, EfficientNet-B0, EfficientNet-B4, ConvNeXt-Base) are trained with two training recipes on a public dataset of 1,720 peanut leaf images (five classes) and evaluated with stratified group five-fold cross-validation, in which near-duplicate images are kept within one fold. Includes an ablation study, a naive-split leakage experiment, robustness tests and Grad-CAM analyses. Trained model weights: https://huggingface.co/Kashif-Mahmood007/peanut-leaf-disease-classifiers. Dataset: https://doi.org/10.17632/x6x5jkk873.2.
